title: The Scarf Incident
letter_points: A pigeon pooped on Arya's favourite scarf ($5, flea market), in broad daylight, in front of everyone.
Arya only has half a photo of it; it got torn in the chaos.
Pigeons are hard to tell apart.

arya_half_photo.text: Arya's half of a torn photo of the incident.

felix_in_photo.text: Alex's half of the photo. Felix is right there, pointing at Arya.

pigeon_photo.text: Felix's photo of the pigeon. Find this pigeon at the plaza!
